title: 第3章 可战王境领悟十八条大道第4章 拉拢威胁
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 先天混元剑体（小成）
剑道领悟速度+1000%
剑道神通威力+1000%
当林玄彻底将先天混元剑体融合后，当真是被它的增幅吓了一大跳。
百分之一千的剑道真意领悟速度！
百分之一千的剑道神通威力！
这是何等的逆天！
这便是红色天命吗？
这还只是小成境界的先天混元剑体！
未免有些太过于逆天了啊。
然而，更逆天的远不止于此。
就在林玄尝试去领悟剑意时……
“叮！恭喜宿主，领悟一重剑意。”
“叮！恭喜宿主，领悟二重剑意。”
“叮！恭喜宿主，领悟三重剑意。”
三重剑意！
要知道，林玄便是剑修，这么多年以来，他无时无刻不在参悟剑意，但别说剑意了，雏形都未曾领悟，可见剑道真意的领悟，是何其之难。
但现在，只是瞬间便领悟了三重剑意……
三重剑意，是什么概念？
哪怕是青阳剑宗，也只有一人领悟了剑意，那便是青阳剑宗的太上长老，玄剑老祖。
而他，也不过领悟了一重剑意罢了。
即便是青阳剑宗宗主，都仅仅只是领悟了剑意雏形，并非真正的剑意。
如今，林玄不仅领悟了剑意，而且还是三重剑意！
剑修，向来以杀力强横著称，而领悟了剑意的剑修，更是无数修士都不愿意去招惹的对象。
青阳剑宗能跻身于唐清帝国十大宗门，极大一部分原因便是因为青阳剑宗之内，有着一位绝世剑修，玄剑老祖。
“如今，哪怕是真正的王境强者，亦可一战！”
林玄眼中闪烁着精光。
这是先天混元剑体，再加上三重剑意给他带来的绝对自信。
当然，这一想法若是被别人知道，只会引起他人的嘲笑。
劫境七重战王境？
天大的笑话！
劫境与王境的差距，如同天堑，别说是劫境七重，哪怕是劫境九重圆满，对上真正的王境强者，也不过是随手便被镇压的存在。
王境之下皆蝼蚁，从来都不只是说说而已。
哪怕十位劫境九重圆满，也不可能是一位王境强者的对手。
时间飞逝，转眼间三个月过去了。
这段时间，林玄一直在炼化六转玄灵丹带来的庞大修为。
短短三个月时间，林玄的境界便从劫境七重，突破到了劫境九重圆满！

Innate Hunyuan Sword Body (Xiao Cheng)
Kendo comprehension speed +1000%
Sword magic power +1000%
When Lin Xuan completely fused the Innate Hunyuan Sword Body, he was really shocked by its increase.
One thousand percent of the speed of comprehending the true meaning of swordsmanship!
One thousand percent of the magical power of swordsmanship!
How outrageous this is!
Is this the red destiny?
This is just the innate Hunyuan Sword Body of the Xiaocheng realm!
It's a little too outrageous.
However, it's even more outrageous than that.
Just when Lin Xuan was trying to understand the meaning of the sword...
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, you have understood the meaning of the sword."
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, you have understood the second sword intention."
"Ding! Congratulations to the host, for understanding the triple sword intention."
Triple sword intent!
You must know that Lin Xuan is a sword cultivator. For so many years, he has been comprehending the sword's intention all the time, but let alone the sword's intention, he has never understood the rudimentary form. This shows how difficult it is to understand the true meaning of the sword.
But now, I realized the triple sword intention in just an instant...
What is the concept of triple sword intent?
Even in the Qingyang Sword Sect, there is only one person who has understood the meaning of the sword, and that is the Supreme Elder of the Qingyang Sword Sect and the ancestor of Xuanjian.
And he only comprehended a level of sword intent.
Even the leader of the Qingyang Sword Sect only understood the prototype of the sword's intention, not the real sword's intention.
Now, Lin Xuan not only understood the sword intention, but also the triple sword intention!
Sword cultivators have always been known for their tyrannical killing power, and sword cultivators who have understood the meaning of the sword are the ones that countless cultivators are unwilling to provoke.
A large part of the reason why Qingyang Sword Sect was among the top ten sects in the Tang and Qing Empire was because there was a peerless sword cultivator in Qingyang Sword Sect, the ancestor of Xuanjian.
"Now, even a true king-level expert can fight!"
Lin Xuan's eyes flashed.
This is the innate Hunyuan sword body, coupled with the absolute confidence brought to him by the triple sword intention.
Of course, if this idea were known to others, it would only cause ridicule from others.
The seventh level of the Tribulation Realm and the Battle of the King Realm?
What a big joke!
The gap between the Tribulation Realm and the King Realm is like a chasm. Let alone the seventh level of the Tribulation Realm, even if one is at the ninth level of the Tribulation Realm, he will be easily suppressed against a true King Realm powerhouse.
There are all ants under the king's realm, and it's never just talk.
Even if ten people at the ninth level of Tribulation Realm are perfect, they cannot be the opponent of a strong King Realm person.
Time flies, and three months have passed in the blink of an eye.
During this period of time, Lin Xuan has been refining the huge cultivation level brought by the Sixth Transformation Xuanling Pill.
In just three months, Lin Xuan's realm has broken through from the seventh level of the Tribulation Realm to the ninth level of the Tribulation Realm!
